scope: Tiny deterministic local contracts; runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Keep identity independent of value
cases.input_contract: Return the event's identity for every domain state. Test two paid events with equal cents but different IDs and verify constructor rejection of a blank ID.
cases.expected: Paid(p1,100), Paid(p2,100), Voided(v1, duplicate), Refunded(r1,25) retain IDs p1, p2, v1, r1. A blank-ID Paid cannot be constructed.
cases.verification: Assert the four IDs in input order and catch IllegalArgumentException for Paid("",100L).

cases.title: Match every defined state
cases.input_contract: Return paid, voided or refunded through an exhaustive pattern match. Include Refunded explicitly; do not use a catch-all branch that labels every unfamiliar state paid.
cases.expected: The four-event fixture yields paid, paid, voided, refunded. Adding another sealed-domain case requires reviewing this match and its tests.
cases.verification: Assert all four classifications. Temporarily inspect an omitted-refund match as a compiler-warning counterexample, then restore the complete implementation.

cases.title: Separate magnitude from signed contribution
cases.input_contract: Return positive cents for Paid, negative cents for Refunded, and zero for Voided. Stored payment/refund magnitudes must remain within constructor bounds. Test observed zero and a rejected negative magnitude.
cases.expected: The fixture contributes 100,100,0,-25. Refunded(r0,0) contributes 0 but remains refunded; Paid with-1 cents is rejected.
cases.verification: Assert exact signed contributions, zero-refund behavior and the constructor failure for a negative paid amount.

cases.title: Create a validated replacement value
cases.input_contract: Return a new Paid value with the same ID and a revised amount, leaving the original unchanged. Use copy and preserve constructor validation for an out-of-domain amount.
cases.expected: Paid(p1,100) revised to 125 becomes Paid(p1,125), while the original remains 100. Amount 1000001 is rejected.
cases.verification: Assert old/new amounts and equal IDs, then catch the out-of-domain constructor failure.

cases.title: Reduce signed events without dropping zero states
cases.input_contract: Compute the checked Long sum of signedCents for every event. Empty input returns 0. Preserve all domain states in the source even when their numerical contribution is zero.
cases.expected: The four-event fixture nets 175 cents. Paid(z,0) and Voided(v, reason) together net 0 while remaining two distinct events.
cases.verification: Assert 175, empty 0, and a two-event zero-total fixture without filtering either event.

cases.title: Reconcile identity, state and net value
cases.input_contract: Reject repeated event IDs, then return IDs in source order, net total, and counts for paid/voided/refunded including zero categories. Do not deduplicate equal monetary amounts.
cases.expected: The fixture returns IDs[p1, p2, v1, r1], net 175 and counts paid 2, voided 1, refunded 1. Repeated ID same is rejected even if both amounts agree.
cases.verification: Assert the full result and count sum 4, then demonstrate that two equal-ID Paid records fail instead of being silently collapsed.
